pages.text: The Energizing Orb performs Powah's special energy recipes.
Place at least one Energizing Rod within a 9×9 area and link the Rod to the Orb with the Powah Wrench in Link mode. The Orb itself does not need a cable connection.
Rods draw FE from cables or adjacent FE blocks and feed the linked Orb. More rods and higher-tier rods increase the available transfer rate.
The exact special recipes are also exposed through the Powah JEI category.
Iron Ingot + Gold Ingot → 2 Energized Steel$(br)Cost: 10,000 FE.
pages.title: Energized Steel

pages.text: Blaze Rod → Blazing Crystal: 90,000 FE.$(br)Or 4 Blaze Powder → Blazing Crystal: 120,000 FE.
pages.title: Blazing Crystal

pages.text: Eye of Ender + Dielectric Casing + Tiny Basic Capacitor → Ender Core$(br)Cost: 50,000 FE.
pages.title: Ender Core

pages.text: 2 Packed Ice → Dry Ice$(br)Cost: 10,000 FE.$(br2)Packed Ice is used because this is the 1.12.2 adaptation.
pages.title: Dry Ice

pages.text: Nether Star + 2 Redstone Blocks + Blazing Crystal Block → 16 Nitro Crystals$(br)Cost: 20,000,000 FE.
